findings.title: Create a fresh timestamp for each assignment source
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when this module is imported, so every `AssignmentSource` created in the process gets the same `queued` timestamp rather than the time that source was created. This makes the context's timing metadata inaccurate, especially for rapid assignment changes; use a per-instance default such as `field(default_factory=timezone.now)`.
